name: Natural and Culturo-Historical Region of Kotor
description: Tucked into the deepest bend of the Bay of Kotor in Montenegro, this walled medieval town sits beneath steep mountains on a sheltered Adriatic harbour. In the Middle Ages it thrived as a trading hub with renowned stonemasons and icon painters. Four Romanesque churches and the ramparts climbing the slope above are among its treasures, restored after the 1979 earthquake.
